faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Senior Project Associate position at AIIMS Delhi is 10 October 2026. Candidates are advised to send their CVs well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Project Associate position at AIIMS Delhi. This is a project-based recruitment for a duration of two years, and the selection will be based on the candidate's qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a four-year Bachelor's degree or Master's degree in Natural/Agricultural Sciences, Engineering, Technology, or Medicine. Alternatively, a Doctoral degree (Ph.D./MD/MS) in relevant fields is also acceptable for this position as per the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the Senior Project Associate recruitment at AIIMS Delhi. Candidates can apply for the position free of cost by sending their resume to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Project Associate post at AIIMS Delhi is 40 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this age criteria as of the date specified in the official notification to be eligible for the selection process.

faq.question: Q6. How should I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates should apply by sending their detailed resume or CV to the official email address provided: [email protected]. Ensure that all relevant documents and educational certificates are attached to the email, and the subject line clearly mentions the post applied for.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a project-based recruitment at AIIMS Delhi. The position is temporary and is for a duration of two years. It is specifically designed for research-related activities within the institute's ongoing projects.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process details are not explicitly provided in the extracted data. Candidates are advised to check the official notification PDF for specific information regarding interviews, written tests, or document verification procedures that may be conducted by the selection committee.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply if I have a Ph.D. degree?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with a Doctoral degree in Science, Engineering, Technology, Pharma, MD, or Master of Surgery are eligible to apply for the Senior Project Associate post. Higher qualifications are welcomed as per the eligibility criteria outlined in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the work location be?
faq.answer: The work location for the Senior Project Associate position is at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) in New Delhi, pincode 110029. Candidates will be working on a project basis within the research department of the institute.
